description.zh:
专属集群ID，可在专属集群控制台的专属集群信息页获取。
> 如需传入多个，ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en:
The ID of the dedicated cluster. You can view the dedicated cluster ID on the Dedicated Clusters page in the ApsaraDB for MyBase console.

> Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
专属集群的主机ID，可调用[DescribeDedicatedHosts](~~200944~~)获取。
> 如需传入多个，ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en:
The ID of the host in the dedicated cluster. You can call the [DescribeDedicatedHosts](~~200944~~) operation to query the host ID.

> Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

description.zh: 数据库类型，取值固定为**Redis**。
description.en: The database engine of the instance. Set the value to **Redis**.

description.zh: 数据库版本号，取值固定为**5.0**。
description.en: The database engine version of the instance. Set the value to **5.0**.

description.zh:
实例ID。
> 该实例必须是通过专属集群创建的，更多信息，请参见[云数据库专属集群MyBase](~~141455~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance.

> The instance must be created by using a dedicated cluster. For more information, see [What is ApsaraDB for MyBase?](~~141455~~)

description.zh:
实例连接地址的网络类型，取值：
* **0**：公网。
* **1**：经典网络。
* **2**：专有网络VPC。
description.en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

*   **0**: Internet
*   **1**: classic network
*   **2**: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)

The state of the instance. Valid values:

*   **0**: The instance is being created.
*   **1**: The instance is running.
*   **3**: The instance is being deleted.
*   **5**: The configurations of the instance are being changed.
*   **6**: The instance is being migrated.
*   **7**: The instance is being restored from a backup.
*   **8**: A master-replica switchover is in progress.
*   **9**: Expired data of the instance is being deleted.

description.zh: 页码，大于**0**且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than **0**. Default value: **1**.
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**. Default value: **30**.
The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~473763~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 可用区ID，您可以调用[DescribeZones](~~473764~~)查询。
description.en: The zone ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeZones](~~473764~~) operation to query the most recent zone list.

title.zh: 查看专属集群实例的列表

descriptions.zh: > 如需查询非专属集群下的实例的信息，请调用[DescribeInstanceAttribute](~~473779~~)。
descriptions.en: > If you want to query the information about Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instances that are not deployed in a dedicated cluster, call the [DescribeInstanceAttribute](~~473779~~) operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-dedicated-cluster-instance-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-e --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --instance-status 1 --instance-net-type 2 --engine Redis --engine-version 5.0 --cluster-id dhg-5f2v98840ioq0000 --dedicated-host-name ch-t4n664a9mal4c0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --region cn-hangzhou
